featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the worst cinema experience at PVR Kandivali. To start with, water was literally leaking from the ceiling onto our seats. Instead of fixing the issue, they just threw a flimsy blue plastic sheet over the seats! It felt like sitting in a rundown shack. Some seats had broken cushions, making it incredibly uncomfortable to sit for the entire movie.

On top of that, the AC wasn’t working, and the whole theatre had a horrible damp, musty smell. It felt like they haven’t maintained the place in ages. The icing on the cake? The volume was cranked up so high, it was uncomfortable and borderline painful to sit through the movie. It didn’t enhance the experience, it made it worse.

This is hands down the worst PVR I’ve ever been to. If you’re planning to watch a movie here, do yourself a favor and go elsewhere. Total waste of time and money!

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

featured_reviews.name: Anish Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Theatre, Borivali offers a consistently enjoyable movie-watching experience. The ambience is pleasant, seating is comfortable, and the overall layout of the theatre is well maintained, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a film.
Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great movie experience at Maxus Cinemas, Borivali! The screens are bright, the sound quality is excellent, and the seats are super comfortable. Instead of providing basic guidance, the staff behaved in an extremely rude and dismissive manner, making an inappropriate remark implying that I shouldn’t come without prior knowledge. I strongly recommend that the management take this matter seriously and ensure that front-desk staff are trained to interact professionally and respectfully with customers. A simple polite response can make a significant difference in customer experience.

Clean, comfortable seating, delicious food options (we tried the momos, pizza, and coffee, along with the usual samosa and popcorn). featured_reviews.name: Suraj Deosarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the INOX multiplex at Raghuleela Mega Mall in Kandivali and had a really pleasant experience overall. The location is quite convenient, especially with the mall offering ample parking and access to food courts and shopping options. As for the multiplex itself, it was clean, well-maintained, and the ambiance was quite inviting.

The staff at INOX were courteous and helpful, right from the ticket counter to the ushers inside the theater. The seating was comfortable, with good legroom and clear visibility from every angle. The sound and picture quality were up to the mark, giving a great cinematic experience. I especially liked the recliner section, which was a bit more expensive but definitely worth it for long movies.

The only reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the food prices at the snack counter are on the higher side, which is typical for multiplexes but still feels excessive. Also, during peak hours, the entry and exit process can feel a bit rushed and crowded.

Overall, INOX Raghuleela is a great place to watch movies with friends or family. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good movie-going experience in Kandivali.

featured_reviews.name: TripperHD Vlogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
INOX at Raghuleela Mega Mall in Kandivali West is a popular multiplex cinema located on the second floor of the mall. It offers a convenient and modern movie-watching experience for the residents and visitors of Kandivali and surrounding areas. The multiplex features multiple screens, including 3D-enabled auditoriums with silver screens, providing immersive cinematic experiences. With a total seating capacity of 1275 across its four auditoriums, it can accommodate a significant number of moviegoers.

Beyond just movie screenings, INOX Raghuleela Mega Mall also provides food and beverage options for patrons to enjoy during their visit. The cinema is wheelchair-friendly, ensuring accessibility for all. Located within the bustling Raghuleela Mega Mall, visitors can easily combine a movie outing with shopping, dining, and other entertainment options available in the mall. Its strategic location near Poisar Bus Depot and off S.V. Road makes it easily accessible by various modes of transport.

featured_reviews.name: Rasesh kumar Dash
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited INOX at Raghuleela Mega Mall, Kandivali, and overall it was a pleasant movie-watching experience. The theatre is conveniently located inside the mall and easy to reach by public transport as well as private vehicles. Entry and security checks were smooth, and the overall crowd management felt organized. Booking tickets online made the process quick and hassle-free.
Inside the auditorium, the seating was comfortable and well spaced, allowing for a relaxed viewing experience. The screen quality was sharp, and the sound system was clear and immersive, which enhanced the impact of the movie. The air-conditioning was well balanced and added to the comfort throughout the show. Cleanliness inside the hall and common areas was maintained properly.
The food and beverage counter offered the usual INOX snacks like popcorn, nachos, and soft drinks. While the prices were slightly on the higher side, the quality and taste were decent. Staff members were polite and helpful whenever assistance was needed.
Overall, INOX Raghuleela Mall Kandivali is a good option for movie lovers looking for comfort, good audio-visual quality, and a reliable cinema experience. It’s a suitable place for family outings, friends, or solo movie plans.

From the excitement of grabbing popcorn and cold drinks to rushing in before the trailers end, every visit feels familiar and comforting. You’ll see college groups laughing loudly, couples sharing popcorn in silence, and solo movie lovers fully lost in the screen. Between shows, there are endless stories—first dates, birthday plans, late-night shows, and post-movie discussions that matter more than the movie itself. For Mumbaikars, INOX Inorbit isn’t just about watching films, it’s about living those little moments that make city life fun and filmy. 🎬✨

featured_reviews.name: The explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this Inox to watch F1 in 4DX. Although the was inox was impeccably clean and well designed,the 4DX effects weren't quite impressive. There were unnecessary seat pushes throughout the movie (almost all the racing scenes) which actually didn't let us focus our eyes on the screen. Two flashlights placed in the hall that threw light at us for nothing and the air blower system that was triggered in just one instance where it was absolutely unnecessary. 4DX is supposed to make the movie watching experience immersive but I guess F1 didn't need an additional 4DX. Still rating the screen a 5 star as the effects could have been better for other movies.
Restrooms were clean and neat as any other INOX. Drinking water with paper cups were placed. There was luckily no disturbance from the staff during or after the interval for their snacks. The chairs allotted were otherwise very comfortable and spacious enough to watch a movie. We had a pleasant time during our movie here. There's also a separate kid's theater and a small hall exclusive for hosting birthday parties at the Inox.

The lift situation wasn’t great either—there’s only one, and it barely fits five people, so getting in and out felt like a waiting game. featured_reviews.name: Kartikeya Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Cinema – Oberoi Mall, Mumbai

I recently visited PVR Cinema at Oberoi Mall, Mumbai, and had a fantastic overall experience. Of course, the cinema itself lives up to the PVR standard – clean, comfortable seating, great sound and picture quality, and a well-maintained ambiance. But what really caught me by surprise this time was the food.

We decided to try the hotdogs, and honestly, they were far better than the typical movie-snack expectations. The buns were perfectly steamed – soft, warm, and fresh – which made a big difference in texture. The sausage was juicy and flavorful, and they nailed the condiment-to-meat ratio. Nothing was overly messy or underwhelming – just a really well-balanced, satisfying bite that felt thoughtfully put together rather than rushed.

Another nice touch was the small Costa Coffee counter inside the cinema area. It’s not a full café, but they do serve the essentials. We ordered an iced latte, and it was surprisingly good – strong but not bitter, with just the right amount of milk and ice. It was a refreshing complement to the hot food and added to the overall premium feel of the experience.

All in all, PVR Oberoi Mall offers more than just movies – it’s clearly putting effort into creating a quality experience across the board, including the food and beverage options. Whether you’re here for a blockbuster or just want a relaxed evening out, this location delivers on multiple fronts. Definitely looking forward to going back.

Visited Movie Max Goregaon with friends to watch Pushpa 2, but the experience was disappointing for several reasons:

2. Toilet Facilities: The number of toilets was very limited, leading to long queues. The toilets were also very small, which was inconvenient for the crowd.

3. Drinking Water: There was no drinking water facility available, which was surprising and inconvenient for the audience.

4. Sound Quality: The sound system was not loud enough, and I missed many dialogues during the movie. This was a major letdown.

Overall, the theater didn’t meet basic expectations for comfort or amenities. I might not visit again unless these issues are addressed. Would recommend exploring better theaters in the area for a more enjoyable movie experience.
